# `collaboration_create`

**Collaboration Create.** Create a bounded thread between 2 to 4 tasks and invite each once.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `collaboration_create` |
| Side effect | `create` |
| Idempotency | keyed on `idempotency_key` |
| Retry safe | yes |
